title: Onosys says payment card data from its restaurant online ordering platform may have been captured; Pizza Ranch customers among those notified
date_note: The day Onosys notified Iowa residents and its counsel's letter to the Iowa Attorney General is dated (November 18, 2026). The notice says Onosys was alerted to unusual activity in October 2026 and that orders placed between October 10 and October 13, 2026 may be affected.
geo_basis: mailing address given in the notice letter (100 Village Drive, Unit 68, Mebane, NC 27302)
summary: Onosys, which runs an online ordering platform for restaurant clients, notified Iowa's Attorney General of a data security incident. Its notice says it was alerted to unusual activity in October 2026 and that payment card information for customers who ordered online between October 10 and October 13, 2026 may have been accessed or captured. The letter lists Pizza Ranch (1539 individuals) and says Onosys notified 1547 Iowa residents.
plain: A company that runs online ordering for restaurants, including Pizza Ranch, says card details from online orders placed over a few days in October 2026 may have been taken. It notified 1547 people in Iowa.
exec: A restaurant online ordering provider says customers' payment card data may have been captured, showing card-skimming risk through ordering vendors.
action: Onosys's notice recommends reviewing current and past credit and debit card statements and calling the card's issuing bank immediately about any suspicious transactions; it offers IDX restoration assistance.
impact: Onosys notified 1547 Iowa residents; the letter lists 1539 individuals for Pizza Ranch. No overall total is given.

sources.name: Iowa Attorney General: NuOnosys, Inc. dba Onosys notice of data security incident (with sample consumer letter)

report.publisher: Onosys, through Constangy, Brooks, Smith & Prophete (filed with the Iowa Attorney General)
key_findings: In October 2026, Onosys was alerted to unusual activity involving its online ordering platform.
Payment card information for customers who placed online orders between October 10, 2026, and October 13, 2026, may have been accessed or captured by an unauthorized actor.
Information that may have been involved includes names, payment card numbers, expiration dates, and security codes.
Onosys notified 1547 Iowa residents on November 18, 2026; the letter lists Pizza Ranch (1539 individuals).
recommendations: Review current and past credit and debit card statements; call the issuing bank immediately about suspected fraud; use the offered IDX restoration assistance.

evidence.quote: Onosys provided notification to 1547 Iowa residents on November 18, 2026, via electronic mail.
Pizza Ranch, Inc. and its affiliates and franchisees operating Pizza Ranch® restaurants in this state (1539 Individuals)

Through its investigation, Onosys learned that payment card information for customers who placed online orders between October 10, 2026, and October 13, 2026, may have been accessed or captured by an unauthorized actor.

validation.note: Primary: Onosys's own notice (counsel's letter and sample consumer letter) filed with and published by the Iowa Attorney General, read in full. No other publisher read.
